summary: Apollo IG Core Replacement, L.P. filed an 8-K reporting unregistered sales of limited partnership interests for ~$6.0 million in cash under Section 4(a)(2)/Reg D/S. The investment manager also determined net asset value of $1,310.9 million as of July 31, 2026, with investments at fair value of $1,311.8 million. This is a routine continuous private offering and NAV disclosure for a closed-end fund, not a special situation. No M&A, tender, restructuring, or strategic event is present.
